mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is called principal maximum and the others as secondary maxima.
The central maximum is called principal maximum and the others as secondary maxima.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a special optical device designed to block light from every other half-period zone.
The Zone Plate The zone plate is a special optical device designed to block light from every other half- period zone.
Fill in the blank: ______ is an exact duplicate of 1P with the exception that it is not partially silvered.
The compensator plate is an exact duplicate of 1P with the exception that it is not partially silvered.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the vibration spiral with gradually smaller and smaller semicircles until eventually it coincides with Z.
The resultant curve is the vibration spiral with gradually smaller and smaller semicircles until eventually it coincides with Z.
Fill in the blank: ______ is used to determine wavelengths precisely, to compare two wavelengths, to calibrate the standard metre in terms of wavelength, etc.
The Fabry- Perot interferometer (or etalon) is used to determine wavelengths precisely, to compare two wavelengths, to calibrate the standard metre in terms of wavelength, etc.

Fill in the blank: ______ is used to illuminate the slits, we obtain an interference pattern consisting of a central 'white' fringe, having on both sides a few coloured fringes and then a general illumination.

White-Light Fringes If white light is used to illuminate the slits, we obtain an interference pattern consisting of a central 'white' fringe, having on both sides a few coloured fringes and then a general illumination.
fib: ______ are the brightest in the central part of the pattern.
The fringes are the brightest in the central part of the pattern.
______ is the perpendicular projection of P on the diameter AOA' of the circle.
The point N is the perpendicular projection of P on the diameter AOA' of the circle.
______ is the distance between the foot of the perpendicular to 0P , i.e., O 0P = b.
Suppose that b is the distance between the foot of the perpendicular to 0P , i.e., O 0P = b.
______ are used to form images using X-rays and microwaves for which conventional lenses do not work.
Today zone plates are used to form images using X-rays and microwaves for which conventional lenses do not work.
______ is used, no fringes will be seen at all except for a path difference so small that it does not exceed a few wavelengths.
White Light Fringes If a source of white light is used, no fringes will be seen at all except for a path difference so small that it does not exceed a few wavelengths.
______ is called the pole of the wavefront with respect to the point 0P.
The point O is called the pole of the wavefront with respect to the point 0P .
